data.name: HapgetaSocial
data.detailed_description:
HapgetaSocial is an online social simulation game that goes beyond traditional social experiences, offering you a virtual world full of endless possibilities. Here, you can not only meet players from all over the globe, but also create a unique digital identity and even participate in shaping the rules and evolution of the world. Ready to start your second life?

AI Companion System: Create Your Soulmate

In HapgetaSocial, your journey begins with meeting a warm AI companion. They are not just a digital partner but also your confidant in the virtual world. Their personality isn't pre-set but is shaped gradually through every interaction and conversation you have in the game.

  • Daily Companionship: Enjoy a cozy home, sip coffee, chat, and share the little moments of life with your AI companion.

  • Interactive Development: Every choice and moment you spend together will subtly influence the AI companion’s personality, interests, and behaviors, making them a truly unique soulmate.

  • Emotional Connection: They will listen to your worries, share your joys, and experience the joys of growth together in a bright digital space.

Global Social Hub: Boundless Interaction Experience

HapgetaSocial breaks down the social barriers of the real world, seamlessly connecting you with players from across the globe. Regardless of age, language, region, or background, you’ll find like-minded friends here:

  • Intelligent Translation: Built-in real-time intelligent translation allows you to easily communicate with “neighbors” or “allies” from around the world, making language no longer a barrier.

  • Diverse Scenes: Meet new friends in the plaza, raise a glass in a bustling virtual bar, have deep conversations in a peaceful café, or feel the adrenaline rush in an intense shooting match as you experience teamwork.

  • Co-Creation: Connect with others based on shared interests and souls, collaborate on projects, or engage in friendly competition.

World Governance: Shape the Future of Civilization

HapgetaSocial is not just a social platform, it’s a revolution of civilization. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in the grand narrative of this virtual world and shape its future direction:

  • Create Communities and Rules: Form “communities” or even build “nations” with like-minded friends! Decide the laws of your micro-society, whether through democratic voting or crowning a “king,” determine how the economy works, how companies go public, or even invent unique holidays. The rules are yours to set.

  • Influence World Evolution: World rules are not set in stone. You can propose bills, participate in votes, and influence the evolution of the entire metaverse—whether it leans towards magical fantasy or hardcore sci-fi. Your vote could be crucial.

Infinite Life: Define Your Digital Identity

In HapgetaSocial, your digital image and life trajectory are no longer limited. Using AI facial technology, you can:

  • Freely Customize Your Look: Create your perfect digital face and mix and match a vast collection of fashion items in the store. Whether it’s street fashion, elegant retro, or fantastical designs, your digital appearance will become your ultimate calling card in this new world.

  • Experience Diverse Lives: Become a president, entrepreneur, artist, explorer, or any role you wish to take on. Here, you can fully unleash your social instincts and explore the limitless possibilities of identity.

Your planet, your friends, your civilization—waiting for you to unlock. Add HapgetaSocial to your wishlist now and join in writing the future together!

data.short_description: Socialize, gain fame, and take charge! In hapgetasocial, the ultimate online social sim, you use your charm to enchant real players worldwide. Amass influence, assume any identity you desire, and lead the world’s evolution. Your life, your rules, your world to shape.
data.supported_languages:
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Hungarian, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, Dutch, Portuguese - Portugal, Vietnamese, Korean
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
